title: All of A Sudden (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy named "humanitude", which is rooted in active listening and respecting residents' dignity, despite strong resistance and disagreement from some of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path and perspective on the world. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

 

Best Actress Award, Cannes Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
巴黎近郊療養院院長瑪莉露致力推行以病人尊嚴與感受為本的護理法，卻屢遇制度及執行上的阻力。她偶然遇上患末期癌症的日本劇作家真理，二人漫步巴黎，慢談生命，一夜之間由陌生人變成靈魂知己，在生命驟變的陰影下互相扶持，共同追尋溫柔、韌性與可能。真摯對話，靜默相守，詰問照顧，死亡與現代資本主義的裂縫。《Drive My Car》導演濱口龍介首部法語作品再度入圍康城影展主競賽單元，維珍妮愛菲亞與岡本多緒演繹出冷漠體制之下互相陪伴與啟發的動人情誼，破天荒贏得雙影后。

 

康城影展 最佳女主角獎

cast: Virginie Efira, Tao Okamoto, Kyozo Nagatsuka, Kodai Kurosaki
